[ THE PRODUCT ]

ONE LOCAL LAYER OVER WINDOWS.

Dexget places a compact, contextual notch at the top of Windows. It expands when the user needs media controls, notifications, timers, search, reminders, files, or assistant actions, then returns to a minimal state.

It is local-first: deterministic Windows actions avoid an LLM, while natural-language planning can use a local Ollama model only when the request requires it.

[ HOW IT WORKS ]

INTENT TO DESKTOP ACTION.

01 / SURFACE

DYNAMIC ISLAND

PyQt6 renders compact and expanded states for current desktop activity.

02 / ROUTE

CLASSIFY INTENT

Known commands take a deterministic path; complex language requests go to the planner.

03 / EXECUTE

USE WINDOWS TOOLS

Accessibility, DOM, keyboard, mouse, files, and system controls perform the task.

04 / CONFIRM

PROTECT RISKY ACTIONS

Destructive file and power operations retain explicit safety confirmations.

[ CAPABILITIES ]

BUILT AS A SYSTEM.

01

CONTEXTUAL ISLAND

Media, timers, charging, battery, notifications, headsets, reminders, and file activities each get purpose-built states.

02

PRODUCTIVITY LAYER

03
